What is OA pattern for Renesas Software Role?

Based on candidate experiences, the Renesas Online Assessment (OA) typically includes a mix of aptitude and technical sections. The aptitude portion focuses on quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and analytical problem-solving. Technical questions commonly cover Digital Electronics, including logic gates, flip-flops, sequential circuits, and finite state machines (FSMs). Candidates also report questions from Verilog/SystemVerilog, testing coding skills, HDL concepts, and testbench development. Programming fundamentals in C and Python are frequently assessed through concept-based and multiple-choice questions. Other important areas include Analog Electronics (such as ADCs and basic analog circuits), Static Timing Analysis (STA) covering setup time, hold time, and timing analysis, and Microprocessors, with an emphasis on architecture and fundamental concepts. Additionally, some assessments may include basic questions from Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, focusing on introductory ML concepts and algorithms.
